02081 Z@biyna' {zeb-ee-naw'}

字根已不使用 (意為"購買"); 陽性專有名詞

AV - Zebina 1; 1

西比拿 = "購買"
1) 尼波的子孫, 以斯拉時代的人, 他曾娶了一外邦女子為妻
(#拉 10:43|)
record.edic_text:
02081 Z@biyna' {zeb-ee-naw'}

from an unused root (meaning to purchase);; n pr m

AV - Zebina 1; 1

Zebina = "bought"
1) a son of Nebo who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
